_notes: Register: tegeződés (informal 'te') for every student-facing string, as Hungarian consumer apps do; staff-facing mobile:agency.*, mobile:university.*, mobile:v3.agency.*, mobile:v3.reviews.*, mobile:v3.uni.*, mobile:v3.tasks.*, mobile:v3.deadlines.*, mobile:v29.mfa.* use concise magázás/impersonal noun labels. Shared mobile:login.*, mobile:settings.*, mobile:messages.* strings that all three apps load stay tegező because the student app is their main reader.

'plan' = csomag everywhere (not 'terv', which means a schedule); 'additional service' = kiegészítő szolgáltatás; 'managed application' = közösen intézett jelentkezés (web and mobile allowance labels were two different renderings).

'matches' (automated fit list) = 'hozzád illő képzések' / button 'Hozzám illő képzések'; the earlier 'egyezések' reads as 'coincidences' in Hungarian. Badges mobile:v3.match.* use 'Illik hozzád' / 'Részben illik hozzád' so no admission chance is implied.
'document review' (team checks a document) = ellenőrzés; the agency action 'verify' (mark as verified) = jóváhagyás, so review and verify stay distinct. 'editing' of essays = lektorálás.

'program' = képzés, 'intake' = felvételi időszak, 'dormitory' = kollégium, 'housing' = lakhatás, 'transcript' = bizonyítvány, 'enrollment' = beiratkozás, 'admission offer' = felvételi ajánlat, 'standard admission letter' = standard felvételi levél, apostille / konzuli felülhitelesítés / közjegyzői hitelesítés kept as official terms; D-2 (hallgatói), D-4 (nyelvtanfolyam).

'Hangyul team' = a Hangyul csapata and 'Hangyul Univ team' = a Hangyul Univ csapata, following the English of each key; four mobile strings that said 'a tanácsadód' (your counselor) now name the team as the English does.

Placeholders never take a Hungarian suffix: name/university/doc placeholders are introduced with 'ide:', 'ezt:', 'erre:', or the a(z) article, e.g. 'Beadva ide: {{university}}.', 'Javítsd ezt: {{label}} ({{university}})'.
Plural _one/_other forms both carry {{count}} with the singular noun, as Hungarian requires after a number.
App names mobile:app.* stay in English (official product names).
